featured_reviews.name: Aditi Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Took my cat to Dr. Deepa’s clinic for gastro issues. She wasn’t diagnosed properly and the staff at the hospital were not able to handle her as well. The diagnosis was wrong and it was extremely difficult to connect with the doctor treating her. I literally had to cry and beg for her them to send me her prescription so that i could start the medicines. Even after that, wrong dosage of the medicine was prescribed. After 15 days of trial and error with the doctor unable to assess what the actual cause was suggested giving her steroids. That was the final straw, after which I took her to another vet who in a second was able to identify her symptoms as possibly due to Giardia and started correct medications immediately. This was later confirmed by her test results as well. Hence, I essentially wasted 15-20 days and trusted the name of Dr. Deepa, since it was highly recommended. Never taking my cat back there again. This review is just to help people decide and make the right choice for their pets as being a pet parent myself, i find it very difficult to find a right doctor for my baby.

featured_reviews.name: steve dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
We brought Ginger, a stray cat, to Deepa’s Clinic in late May after he lost weight and was attacked by another cat. Other vets, including a multi-specialty hospital, said his condition was severe and he wouldn't survive more than a couple of days.

Under Dr. Trisha D’souza's care, Ginger was systematically diagnosed for weight loss due to high creatinine, treated for wounds, and corrected an abscess from a previous vet's IV. After weeks of testing by Dr. Trisha, Dr. Deepa, and Dr. Aditya, Ginger made a remarkable recovery. He went from 1.94 kgs to a healthy 5.3 kgs.

Dr. Deepa’s Clinic follows modern practices, has a great facility, and a compassionate staff. They not only care for pets but also show empathy towards pet parents. They take the time to explain diagnoses and courses of action during visits.

We highly recommend Dr. Deepa’s Clinic—your pets are in good hands

featured_reviews.name: Siddhi Vetal
featured_reviews.review_text: My beautiful, playful 3 year old kitty Koko suffered from a severe spinal injury unbeknownst to me with her symptoms showing up in the beginning of May. It had caused her to become paralyzed in her hind legs and she was as a result unable to use her litterbox or walk. She was unable to apply pressure of any kind using her lower half due to disk compression/herniation as diagnosed by the vets at Tata Trust small animal hospital. I was told that she may never walk again and that I should consider putting her down due to concerns regarding her quality of life with her being unable to poop or pee on her own. I was heart broken for my little girl and felt defeated. A day later I found out about Dr. Deepa Katyal's clinic and wasted no time in starting her treatment there. Dr. Deepa and her expert staff handled our case with so much love, care and dedication which helped Koko regain the strength in her legs within a week. After a month of daily treatments consisting of phototherapy and electroacupuncture Koko feels brand new and is back to being her usual energetic and mischievous self. I feel such relief as I watch her chase her little brother around the house and use the litterbox all on her own with ease just like she used to. I am eternally grateful to Dr. Deepa Katyal and her incredible staff for helping my Koko recover so miraculously and their selfless commitment to the cause of animal pain management. Needless to say Dr. Deepa Katyal's clinic is my go to for addressing any concerns regarding both of my cats. If any of you are in a similar situation, my heart goes out to you; Dr. Deepa Katyal's Animal Wellness and Rehabilitation Centre will take care of your pet and you♡

featured_reviews.name: sms sweta
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a pet parent, I’m sure many of you will understand the kind of fear and helplessness we feel when something isn’t right with our baby. I went through exactly that when my 14-year-old feline, Goldie, was diagnosed with a serious tumour on her left paw. Those days were filled with worry, questions, and uncertainty.

All we knew was that we needed the right oncologist — someone we could trust completely. That’s when we found the incredible team at Superpets, and from that very first visit, everything began to feel a little lighter.

From explaining the diagnosis and possible causes, to guiding us through every test, every step was handled with so much patience, clarity, and compassion. What truly stood out was how reassuring the entire team was — always available to answer questions, clear doubts, and take that extra effort to make both us and Goldie feel comfortable.

The journey — from diagnosis, to surgery, to post-operative care and stitch removal — was smoother than we could have ever hoped for. Every decision they made felt right, thoughtful, and in Goldie’s best interest.

A special note of gratitude to Dr. Pratyush, Dr. Vasudha, and Dr. Gauri — you are truly angels in disguise. The care, dedication, and gentleness with which you handled Goldie means the world to us. It’s not just medical expertise, but your genuine love for animals that makes all the difference.

I must admit, I was initially skeptical about traveling all the way from the suburbs to Bandra for treatment — but today, I can say with complete conviction that every visit, every effort, was absolutely worth it.

What touched me deeply was that even after a month, Dr. Pratyush personally followed up to check on Goldie’s health. That level of care is rare and speaks volumes about the kind of people they are — not just doctors, but true lifesavers.

This entire experience has been a journey of gratitude. People like them are not just treating animals — they are healing families.

Thank you, Superpets team, from the bottom of my heart, for taking such beautiful care of our baby.

Forever grateful. 🙏🏻

featured_reviews.name: Yash Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t thank Superpets enough for the incredible care they’ve provided to my two cats.

Dr. Yash is a highly skilled veterinarian and has build this amazing facility where pets receive world-class care. Everybody in the team from the doctors to the reception staff have genuine compassion towards animals.

I am deeply grateful to Dr. Ashok and Dr. Vasudha for their constant guidance for both my cats over time. On more than one occasion, they literally saved the life of one of my cats who was critically sick. Thanks to them, my cat got a second chance to life.

I highly recommend Superpets!! My cats are healthy and happy today because of this amazing team. Thank you for everything you do❤️

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Chhangani
featured_reviews.review_text: A very professional and qualified set of Doctors who streamline diagnosis and start the correct treatment extremely fast without wasting any time. Thankful to Dr. Omkar for his professionalism and patience with all my questions. He started the diagnosis & treatment for my 48 day old Lab puppy when we rushed him in at 12am. Follow-ups were extremely smooth thanks to Dr. Shefali as she was extremely kind and generous with my pet. She knew exactly what needed to be done and the internal communication between the doctors are spot on and on the same page. I really loved the fact that each doctor is on the same page even the one who is not treating my puppy, Dr. Nishant. The set of Doctors help and consult each other well to discuss exactly which treatment will be right for the pet. I used to believe SuperPets is an expensive clinic which will keep doing tests to increase bill but when I visited the clinic I realised, I was so wrong. Everything right from follow-ups, to chat support, to the doctors actually calling/messaging you to check how your pet is doing post the treatment are all just professional and seamless. I would recommend SuperPets 10/10 after my experience.

featured_reviews.name: Mira Saraf
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been taking my dogs, Angel and Cookie, as well as our new kitten Oreo to Dr. Gauri and Dr. Pratyush (and more recently Dr. Nikhil) at Superpets for the last several years, and they've all been really well-looked after. They never push me towards any unnecessary treatments, but when there is an issue, they handle it quickly and effectively, explaining all the options. They give me peace of mind, and I appreciate the care they've taken with my animals. They're very good and very professional. I would definitely recommend them!

featured_reviews.name: Darshana M
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the best vet experience I've had till now. All the staff, including the service staff are very courteous, kind and helpful. All the vets are patient and explain the issues. Thank you to Drs Nikhil, Nishant and Yash. The only problem is that they don't believe in a vegan diet and wanted me to give animal products to my dog, which is against my ethics. The billing needs to be streamlined as I had to wait after the treatment was done for the first few days and follow up with the staff for NEFT payments. All in all, we need such well equipped and round the clock hospitals with such attentive staff iin each and every city, town and village.

featured_reviews.name: Megan DSa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ive always had good experience with hospital. The staff is extremely caring, patient, and clearly passionate about animals. The vets take the time to explain everything in detail and make sure you’re comfortable with the treatment plan. What stood out the most was how gently and attentively they handled my pet which instantly put me at ease.

The clinic is clean, well-maintained, and organized, which adds to the overall sense of trust.  I truly appreciate the level of professionalism and compassion shown here. Highly recommend this place to any pet parent looking for reliable and quality care.

featured_reviews.name: Smitaa Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a blessing. My German shepherd champ was taken to super pets in an emergency situation. He had developed something called GDV. I was unaware if this situation being a pet parent since more than 17 years now (I have had pets since several years) After taking him to vetic hospital for emergency (which was extremely careless and didn’t even treat it like emergency) post his X-ray on recommendation from some friends I rushed him to super pets. They immediately took charge of the situation. He underwent operation and was discharged in 5 days. We had to take him for regular follow ups and on a follow up in a weeks time, doctors suspected something wrong and again on further tests discovered that his spleen had got affected and damaged along with few further conditions that had developed. He underwent second surgery. He battled for his life for a month in this hospital. He was hospitalised. The care, affection and love he recieved along with the proper medical care is nothing less than a gift for parents seeing their child fight for life and death each day. Inspite of he being aggressive he was pampered and taken care of as if he belongs to them. His entire body had collapsed and post 1 month he finally got discharged. He had lost his ability to walk post all this condition as his hip and spine had got affected. We continued Physio with them. It’s October today. My boy got discharged in June and we are in our way for our regular Physio all hail and hearty, not just walking but running and bullying my other 2 dogs :) No words can thank them enough. His recovery is nothing less than a miracle only because of timely care and attention given to him by the super vets at super pets.

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Phatak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to appreciate the superpets veterinary clinic for the professionalism and high standards of hygiene maintained during my cat’s surgery. The doctors and staff were extremely professional, attentive, and helpful.
The clinic was clean, which was my main concern and well-maintained, which gave me confidence that my pet was in safe hands. The team ensured to provide clear guidance throughout.
Overall, I am grateful for the dedicated care and professional and caring approach shown by the clinic while treating my cat. Highly appreciated.

featured_reviews.name: Shahid Khan

I am heartbroken and devastated by the experience I had at Happy Tails. I brought my beloved male cat here for treatment, hoping he would receive the care he needed. Unfortunately, the treatment provided not only failed to help him but made his condition significantly worse. Tragically, he passed away after their so-called "care."

It's clear that the doctors here are inexperienced, and many seem to be trainees who lack the knowledge and skills required to treat pets properly. They appeared unsure of what they were doing, and their actions reflected a lack of expertise that ultimately led to the loss of my precious cat.

I strongly advise anyone who loves their pet to avoid this clinic at all costs. Do not trust your pet's life to the hands of these incompetent veterinarians. The pain of losing my cat is unbearable, and I wouldn't wish this experience on anyone else.

featured_reviews.name: Malavika Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Took my 2 months old kitten  (Martha) for an emergency at night and I am highly impressed with the way they handled my kitten and us as well, me and my friends were all worried and maybe crying too, but the staff not once told us to leave till she was stabilized and all the formalities were done and no urgency was shown at the paper works as well, right from the reception to the doctor everyone remained calm and empathetic. Emergency oxygen was given to her at the very moment which probably saved her life. Was lucky enough to be attended by Dr Nameeta, she is an EXCEPTIONAL doctor and we found out over time,  Martha was admitted for 2 nights, they told us that that we can call anytime to check on her which I did twice and both the time Dr Nameeta gave me updates at 2 am and 5 am respectively and REALLY THANK YOU FOR THIS, but Martha had lost her complete muscle tonicity and I was not very hopeful. On the 3rd day morning 9am I was send the video by the hospital of her running around, they called me and told that I can take her home. And since then she has been in best of the health and I only take her to Happy Tails Chembur to Dr Nameeta she is one of THE BEST Vet in the city and I have seen lot of them, there was one particular incident which needs a mention as being a doctor myself I feel its very important to show empathy regardless of what the results are but Dr Bhageswari told me its of no point keeping Martha in hospital as she is "only eating and pooping so its a waste of money so take her home" She must be a good vet to other pets but that particular day she wasn't a good vet to Martha. Regardless of this I kept Martha for another day and Dr Nameeta advised me to keep her for one more night under observation and well her decision was very correct. Take your pet to this place and look for Dr Nameeta or Dr Rishikesh and you wont regret it.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review about a stray cat named “Leopard” who eventually became our family member. Request you to please read it till end, as it may be helpful to any pet parent.
Leopard met with an accident and was missing for a week’s period. Later we found him & we noticed that he had a fracture at shoulder of right forelimb. Doctors told us that leg needs to be operated by inserting rod in his leg, so we got him operated by Dr. Sunetra. The surgery went well, but three days after surgery, Leopard's operated leg started swelling, we informed Dr. Sunetra but she told us it is the swelling due to surgery and it will subside downwards. But that swelling was due to infection and it lead to pus formation. Next day the swelling increased and in the evening pus started oozing out, seeing this we called up Dr. Sunetra & rushed to her with our Leopard. Dr. told us to keep flushing the wound twice a day with betadine. After 2-3 days of this treatment, the skin around the infected area went dead and we had a clear sight of his wound with operated area, where we could see his bone from two points because healing was not completed & the stitches were opened. We even asked Dr. Sunetra the doubt in our mind that this infection will not spread in his operated leg & internal body, to which she responded, it would not.
Eventually his external pain reduced but he had internal pain, which we failed to understand. He could not tolerate the pain and stopped eating and got fever exactly on 8th day from operation. We informed this situation of Leopard at every visit to Dr. Sunetra, but she recommended to force feed our Leopard. Later on our Leopard left with no energy to walk on his own and lift his neck, he even started heavy breathing. After informing this situation to Dr. Sunetra, she then advised us to put saline for his recovery but nowhere had she conveyed that Leopard’s health is deteriorating & he needs hospitalization. At this time, she was going out of town & was not available for 4-5 days.
Since, Dr. Sunetra was not available, we went to other Vet doctor who knew Leopard's medical history. This doctor told us to continue saline treatment twice a day for at least 4-5 days. Here the blood test was also done to examine the condition of our Leopard, where the report came with alarming & critical output depicting WBC increased & Platelets dropped to severe condition. Even this doctor also not recommended that our Leopard require hospitalization. This was the 11th day after operation.
